item.title: Who will step up to preserve space age artefacts for future generations?
item.description: NASA/JPL-Caltech Around 40,000 years from now, the Voyager 1 probe will pass within astronomical spitting distance of the star Gliese 445. From there, it will continue drifting through the universe on an endless journey that marks humanity’s first attempt to reach the stars. Voyager 1 – which on 18 November will have travelled one light day from Earth – began its odyssey almost 50 years ago, meaning it has been operating for the majority of the space age. That makes it a rarity: most of our iconic spacecraft ended their lives burned up in Earth’s atmosphere or in bits at the bottom of the ocean. Two of the most important missions still flying today, the Hubble Space Telescope and the International Space Station, look set to share the same fate in the near future, even as scientists call for Hubble to be preserved . While some craft like the space shuttles are on display in museums, our present space history is, essentially, in its dark ages, with little thought currently given to preserving spacecraft in situ, where our space-travelling descendants may wish to marvel at them. Even the Apollo hardware left behind on the moon has almost no protection in international law. Advertisement Perhaps we need an organisation like the UNESCO World Heritage Committee to designate important space artefacts for preservation, and encourage funding from cultural and heritage budgets, not scientific ones, to do this. Of course, with such budgets often under threat and the US set to leave UNESCO at the end of this year, this could introduce new problems. Private philanthropy is another option. If humanity is to one day take its place among the stars, a fantasy that fuels many a tech billionaire, it would be a great shame to not be able to look back at how we got there. Just as we remember 19th-century captains of industry like Andrew Carnegie and J. P. Morgan for funding great cultural institutions, perhaps we should be lobbying for the creation of a Musk Space Museum or Bezos Orbital Institute.

item.title: Killer Bigfoot evidence rejected by Bigfoot’s biggest fans
item.description: Josie Ford Feedback is our weekly column of bizarre stories, implausible advertising claims, confusing instructions and more Caught on camera One of the defining features of conspiracy theories is that they are “self-sealing”. If you confront a conspiracy theorist with the lack of evidence for their claim, they will turn this back on you and argue that this very lack of evidence is proof of how powerful the conspiracy is. This is foreshadowing. Advertisement Feedback is interested in watching the new documentary Capturing Bigfoot . We can’t, because we live in the UK and it isn’t available here , but if anyone would care to rectify that, we will stick ourselves in front of it immediately. The film is about the classic footage that purports to show a Bigfoot loping alongside a river in California. Shot by Roger Patterson and Robert Gimlin in 1967, the clip became one of the canonical pieces of evidence for the existence of Bigfoot: a mythical humanoid that supposedly lives in the forests of North America. Bigfoot is one of the icons of cryptozoology, the search for probably-nonexistent creatures. It has hordes of devotees. In Capturing Bigfoot , film-maker Marq Evans uncovers what really happened in 1967. He speaks to Patterson’s associate Bob Heironimus, who says he wore an ape costume in the footage. Crucially, Evans also finds a lost piece of 16-millimetre film, shot in 1966, showing a rehearsal for the final Patterson-Gimlin video. A review of the documentary in Variety calls this footage “the smoking gun”. It is, Feedback would suggest, a case no defence lawyer could wriggle out of. So, the Patterson-Gimlin film purporting to show Bigfoot was fake. Feedback and our editor worried if we were legally safe saying that, but then, as our editor said, “come on”. It is perhaps telling that, when we mentioned this to Mrs Feedback, her response was “I could have sworn I already knew that”. Indeed, these accusations have been made before, notably in Greg Long’s 2004 book The Making of Bigfoot . The new thing is that rehearsal footage. Naturally, then, this footage is what the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization pushed back on. Its president is quoted in The Times as saying: “My initial reaction is, how could you believe that in the age of AI?… Even if they found some reel, how would you know whether what they’re showing in the documentary is what’s on the reel?” And thus the foreshadowing pays off. A not-so-helpful acronym In late October, a lot of websites suddenly went offline. This was because of a vulnerability in the PHP programming language, which had been known since 2024 but was thought to be too difficult to exploit, until AI tools found how to do it. Reader Chris Hall had never heard of PHP. This seems to have been a common experience: even the BBC’s cyber correspondent Joe Tidy only learned of the existence of PHP when the story broke. item.title: Extraordinary image of bioluminescent plankton captured by photographer
item.description: Lucifer’s Vortex by Tom Fecht Tom Fecht On the edge of twilight, the surface of the sea glows. Millions of tiny dots produce an eerie blue light, barely visible to humans. Each one is a single plankton shining with bioluminescence, and the dots’ light blurs together as the waters churn around them. Tom Fecht captured this image in Brittany, France, looking down into the Atlantic Ocean under a bright moon. The luminescence of the plankton is dim, so his first attempts to catch it resulted in nothing but darkness. “I figured something must be going on which you couldn’t see with the naked eye, so I just blindly started opening the shutter every time a wave broke,” says Fecht. Finally, he captured the light from the plankton mixing with reflections of moonlight in a churning wave. He titled the image Lucifer’s Vortex after the compounds, called luciferins, that generate this light. While these plankton aren’t officially endangered – no plankton species is, in part due to the impossibility of tracking them individually – their future is highly uncertain. Warmer waters force them to migrate polewards and, in some places, die off, their access to nutrients blocked by changing ocean currents. Advertisement The word “luciferin” comes from the Latin for “light-bringer”, and Fecht hopes the plankton’s otherworldly glow also brings light to the plight they face. “If you want to engage in protecting nature, you first of all need an understanding of its beauty,” he says. This image is part of the touring Storm exhibition from the Prix Pictet award, on view at Fotografiska Shenzhen in China until 29 November.

item.title: Ayra Starr Joins Coachella 2027 Lineup Alongside SZA, Dua Lipa & More
item.description: Ayra Starr returns with her third studio album, Starrgirl. Ayra Starr is taking her global run to another big stage! The Nigerian singer has been named among the performers at Coachella 2027, adding another major festival appearance to her growing list of international milestones. The Beninese-born singer, who rose to prominence as one of Afrobeats’ leading voices after joining Mavin Records, is set to perform on both weekends of the festival, Sunday, April 11, and Sunday, April 18, 2027. Coachella will take place at the Empire Polo Club in Indio, California. It’s been a big year for Ayra, with her third studio album, Starrgirl, adding to an already exciting run. Fans heading to the festival can look forward to hearing songs from the project, including “ Tornado ” and “ Midnight in New York “, as well as her collaboration “ Gimme Dat “. There’s also room for crowd favourites such as “ Rush “, “ Commas ” and “ Heaven Baby “. Ayra shares the Sunday bill with headliner SZA , alongside Victoria Monét , Jorja Smith , Becky G and Don Toliver . The wider festival, running from April 9 to 11 and April 16 to 18, will also feature headliners Dua Lipa and Tame Impala , with Madonna set for a special appearance in the dance tent. Her Coachella booking follows another major moment in London, where she performed at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium as part of the NFL International Games halftime show, becoming the first African artist to headline the show. And there’s even more for fans to look forward to. Ayra has announced her 20-city Starrgirl World Tour, which will take her across Europe and North America in early 2027 before she heads to the California desert for Coachella. What a year ahead for the Starr girl. The official Coachella 2027 lineup featuring Nigerian singer Ayra Starr alongside headliners Dua Lipa, Tame Impala, and SZA at the Empire Polo Club in Indio, California. item.title: Beyond The Sole: How Nigerian Artist Eugene Is Turning Waste Into Beauty For A Better World
item.description: An art project that started as a final-year assessment at Auchi Polytechnic, Auchi, Edo State, Nigeria, has turned into a full-time career for Konboye Eugene. In his studio in Kuto, Abeokuta, Ogun State, the Nigerian artist is giving discarded footwear a new lease of life, transforming them into colourful portraits. “I’ve been a full-time studio practitioner for about seven years now. I started when I was in my final year at Auchi Polytechnic, where I studied painting,” Eugene said. “It started as an assignment for me when I was in school. But over the course of my practice, I have become a bit more environmentally aware.” ﻿ Statistics cited by Green Network Asia indicate that over 200 million pairs of flip-flops are discarded each year globally, contributing significantly to plastic and rubber pollution in landfills and oceans. Materials ‘Everywhere, Anywhere’ Eugene’s craft draws attention to the environmental impact of discarded footwear and the need for better ways to manage waste. “I source my material through landfills, the streets, literally everywhere, anywhere,” he added. This image shows Eugene assessing discarded footwear he used for his artwork. (Photo: ChannelsTV/Kenny Akinwunmi) The artist shares the detailed process of how he brings each work of art to life. “My process entails getting the materials first, after which we wash them. After we wash them, we have to select and separate them according to their colours, tones, and values.” “I work in two different ways. There’s the assemblage part, where I assemble the footwear. And there’s also the tapestry, where I have to break them into tiny circles and fix them together using copper and aluminium wire,” Eugene explained. Statistics cited by Green Network Asia indicate that over 200 million pairs of flip-flops are discarded each year globally, contributing significantly to plastic and rubber pollution in landfills and oceans. Creating each piece of artwork comes with its challenges, as Eugene says the process can take between two and six months, depending on its size and complexity. “There are a whole lot of challenges that come with the work. There are times when we’re working and have creative blockages. And also, because we work with sharp objects like knives, needles, and all that, there’s also the hazard that comes with it. “I think we work between two to six months, depending on the size and complexity of what we’re working on in the studio,” he said. For Eugene, the message goes beyond the finished artwork, as he hopes his work will change how people perceive and handle discarded materials. “These are materials that are known to be non-biodegradable, meaning all the footwear that I’ve used over the course of the years, they’re all out there. So we are creating awareness through this work so people know what and how to manage their footwear and other fashion waste,” he noted. ‘Reduce, Reuse, Recycle’ Climate change expert Olumide Idowu agrees with Eugene and is calling for more

item.title: 2 Detroit Lions Will Almost Certainly Miss Germany Game
item.description: The Detroit Lions received some encouraging injury news Wednesday as they prepare for Sunday’s matchup against the New England Patriots in Germany. However, head coach Dan Campbell also revealed that two key starters remain unlikely to play. According to Wednesday’s update, Campbell said defensive end DJ Wonnum is expected to return to practice after missing Sunday’s 19-9 victory over the Miami Dolphins with a concussion. As long as Wonnum avoids any setbacks, Campbell believes he should be available against New England. Unfortunately, the news wasn’t nearly as promising for center Cade Mays and cornerback D.J. Reed. Neither player is expected to practice Wednesday, and Campbell indicated that both are doubtful at best for Sunday’s game. Minnesota Vikings quarterback Kyler Murray (1) almost has his pass blocked by Detroit Lions edge rusher DJ Wonnum (98) that lead to an incomplete pass on the third down, during the first half of the N.F.L. game at Ford Field in Detroit, Sunday, Nov. 1, 2026. Credit: USA TODAY Network via Reuters Connect (Reuters) Detroit Lions Could Get DJ Wonnum Back Wonnum’s potential return would provide an important boost to Detroit’s defensive front. The veteran pass rusher was among five Lions ruled out against Miami , leaving Detroit shorthanded on defense. According to the Lions’ official November 6 injury report , Wonnum did not practice last week while dealing with his concussion. Wednesday’s expected return represents an encouraging development, although his availability remains dependent on avoiding setbacks and receiving the necessary clearance. Meanwhile, the outlook for Mays and Reed remains concerning. Both players were already expected to miss last Sunday’s game , and neither appears particularly close to returning. Mays continues to deal with an ankle injury, while Reed is recovering from a hip injury. According to the Lions’ official inactive report against Miami , veteran Juice Scruggs started at center in Mays’ absence, while Detroit relied on its secondary depth without Reed. The Lions will continue monitoring all three players throughout the week before making final decisions on their availability. For now, Wonnum appears to be trending in the right direction, while Mays and Reed face an uphill battle to suit up against the Patriots.

item.title: Bomb threats force evacuation of schools across Italy
item.description: Schools across Italy were evacuated on Wednesday following a series of bomb threats, which Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni described as hoaxes, insisting that there was no concrete danger. The threats, which reportedly affected about 6,000 schools, according to Italian news agency Ansa, citing the Education Ministry, also prompted security concerns in Britain and Ireland, where threatening emails were sent to hundreds of schools. Meloni convened a government meeting with security and intelligence chiefs on Wednesday to review the incidents. Although it was unclear how many Italian schools evacuated their students, crowds of schoolchildren were seen outside educational institutions in different parts of the country. Some students said they had to leave their classrooms hurriedly, abandoning their belongings while awaiting police checks. A 19-year-old student at Rome’s Virgilio High School, Sofia De Ponte, told AFP that the school’s principal announced that a bomb threat had been received by email before ordering an evacuation. “The principal came out into the courtyard and told us that an email had come in, a bomb threat, and right after that the building was evacuated,” she said. De Ponte said the police had yet to arrive because “there’s a long waiting list with all the schools”. “We’re still here waiting,” another student, Elena Sicignano, 19, said. At Brera school in Milan, art teacher Violetta Uboldi said some students appeared delighted by the unexpected break from classes. “I think there was a cry of joy because school was over. That was the reaction,” she said. However, a 16-year-old student, Angelica, said the situation initially caused panic because a teacher had told them it was not a drill. Italian media reported that the threatening email was purportedly signed by a person identified as “Mikhail Andropov, leader of the Vilayat of Misoginistan”. The message claimed that an explosive device had been placed inside a school building and could be detonated remotely. Government Rules Out Immediate Danger The Italian government sought to reassure the public, saying preliminary security checks had not uncovered evidence of an imminent threat. In a Facebook post, Meloni said: “At present, based on the checks carried out, no element has emerged that would suggest there is a concrete danger.” She added that the reports appeared to be part of a strategy designed to cause alarm and concern, adding that investigations were ongoing. Antonello Giannelli, president of the ANP association of Italian school heads, also described the threats as clearly fake. However, he warned that the incident demonstrated how irresponsible actions, amplified by modern communication tools, could cause widespread disruption. “We hope that full light will quickly be shed on the origin of these threats and that those responsible will be identified,” he said. item.title: Skip Bayless says Carson Wentz ‘can’t play football’ after Vikings performance vs Bills
item.description: Photo by Stephen Maturen/Getty Images Carson Wentz’s performance on Monday Night Football drew heavy criticism from everyone in the NFL community, and Skip Bayless joined in by going off on the quarterback. The 33-year-old threw for 81 yards and completed only 8 passes out of 25 attempts, which meant he had a completion rate of only 32%. Wentz ended up with a passer rating of 8.9, which is the lowest for any player with 25 or more passes in the NFL since 2019. His inability to get the ball to the end zone led the Vikings to suffer a 6-23 defeat and pushed them out of the top place in the NFC North. This was Wentz’s chance to prove that he could take over Kyler Murray as the starter, but he put on a horrific performance, which led to the Vikings deciding to trade for Kirk Cousins at the trade deadline, which was just a day after the game. Skip Bayless believes Carson Wentz is not accurate consistently Wentz was a regular starter in the league for 7 seasons. He was a second pick in the 2016 draft by the Philadelphia Eagles; however, he was never able to fulfil the promise he showed at North Dakota State. In the games he has started, Wentz has thrown for over 23,000 yards and completed 62.7% of his passes. But none of that impressed Bayless, who fired shots at Wentz, discussing his performance on Monday Night Football. “I have been hard on him. I was hard on Carson Wentz coming out of college before he got drafted. I didn’t like him at North Dakota State. I didn’t like his poise or his feel. He’s one of those guys who’s the prototype 6’5, 240-pound, rocket-arm quarterback who can’t play football, and he’s not accurate consistently. All he can do is throw it through a brick wall. Well, that’s not how you win NFL games at the highest level,” said Bayless on Gridiron. With Cousins now set to take over the reins as the starting quarterback, Wentz’s future with the Vikings could be questionable. They already have Kyler Murray, who can play as the backup. He is definitely a good piece to have on a team, as he has proven experience starting games, which not a lot of backups in the league have. However, after his performance against the Bills, fans would definitely not be happy if they see him take snaps under center. item.title: Are the Wizards Asking Too Much of Kyshawn George?
item.description: The Washington Wizards have been trying to understand what their young roster can become. Kyshawn George is making a strong case for a big role with the Wizards, but his recent performances have also raised questions about whether the Wizards are putting too much responsibility on him too soon. George has shown that he can help this team in several areas of the game. The 6-foot-7 forward has become a key piece of the Wizards’ offense, using his scoring ability and creative playmaking to make opportunities for himself and his teammates. Over the last few games, George has become particularly encouraging. George scored 22 points against the Orlando Magic on Nov. 2, followed by 25 points facing the Atlanta Hawks on Nov. 4. He then dropped 33 points in another loss to Atlanta the next game, adding eight assists and five three-pointers. Those numbers show why Washington has continued to give George opportunities with the ball in his hands. However, his development isn’t just about scoring and how many points he can score. The Wizards also need to find the right role for him as he continues to improve in the NBA. Kyshawn George over the last 3 games: 33 PTS – 4 REB – 7 AST – 52% FG 25 PTS – 4 REB – 7 AST – 71% FG 22 PTS – 4 REB – 5 AST – 60% FG pic.twitter.com/xbGk1Bgtuh — Hoop Central (@TheHoopCentral) November 7, 2026 Finding the Right Role for Kyshawn George One of Kyshawn George’s biggest strengths has been his versatility. He’s been able to score, defend multiple positions, and help create offense for his teammates. Washington has also been experimenting with using him as a point guard when Trae Young is not playing. That responsibility has not always been easy. George recorded eight turnovers against the Toronto Raptors on Oct. 23, a performance that showed some of the challenges of asking him to run the Wizards’ offense. He has the ability to make plays, but becoming a good ball handler takes time. After George’s 22-point performance on the Chicago Bulls defense on Oct. 24, Wizards coach Brian Keefe discussed his ability to create more opportunities by getting into the paint. “You saw him being able to create and get into the paint,” Keefe said. “A lot more paint touches for us tonight, which we wanted to emphasize, and he was a catalyst for that.” The comments, reported by Roundtable Sports , show that Washington finds value in what George can bring when he is attacking the basket instead of forcing himself to make all of the plays. The Wizards should continue giving him opportunities to handle the ball, but they should also recognize when he’s most effective. Kyshawn George 33-4-7 (10/19 FG, 5/7 3P) pic.twitter.com/Z1ptTI7V36 — Brett Usher (@UsherNBA) November 7, 2026 Learning Alongside Trae Young Trae Young’s presence could play an important role in George’s development. item.title: EU commits €112m to Nigeria’s security, migration management
item.description: By Favour Ulebor, Abuja The European Union (EU) has committed €112 million to support Nigeria’s security operations and migration management efforts as part of measures to strengthen bilateral cooperation between both sides. The EU disclosed this in a statement on Wednesday following the visit of its Commissioner for Internal Affairs and Migration, Mr Magnus Brunner, to Abuja, where he held meetings with key members of the Nigerian government. The funding comprises €66 million for migration-related projects, €26 million for security interventions, including efforts to tackle the proliferation of small arms and drug trafficking, and €20 million under the European Peace Facility to support Nigeria’s counterterrorism efforts. During the visit, Brunner met with the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Ambassador Bianca Odumegwu-Ojukwu; Attorney-General of the Federation and Minister of Justice, Mr Lateef Fagbemi (SAN); Minister of Interior, Dr Olubunmi Tunji-Ojo; and Minister of Humanitarian Affairs and Poverty Reduction, Dr Bernard Doro. The visit came a day after Nigeria and the EU signed the EU-Nigeria Readmission Agreement, aimed at strengthening cooperation on migration management and facilitating the return of Nigerians who do not have the right to remain in EU member states. The EU said its migration partnership with Nigeria had recorded significant improvements in recent years, particularly through cooperation between Nigerian authorities and European agencies, including Europol, Eurojust and Frontex. It added that the partnership had expanded beyond migration to cover security, trade, regional economic cooperation and other areas of mutual interest. According to the statement, bilateral relations gained further momentum following the eighth EU-Nigeria Ministerial Meeting held in Abuja in March, with the participation of the EU High Representative for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy, Kaja Kallas. The EU also disclosed that its Global Gateway initiative was being implemented in Nigeria through several projects across different sectors by the EU and its member states under the Team Europe approach. Speaking on the partnership, Brunner said: “Nigeria is a key partner for Europe, and our ties are steadily growing stronger. Together we are turning dialogue into action: more security, better migration management, joining forces to bring results. We are turning the huge potential of our partnership into mutual benefit.” He said the visit provided an opportunity to review the partnership, advance cooperation on shared priorities and prepare for further engagement between both sides in areas beyond migration and security. item.title: Marcus Rashford races to be fit for Liverpool trip as Man Utd put new recovery programme in place for his groin problem
item.description: Manchester United v Tottenham Hotspur - Premier League 2026/27 - Getty Images Sport Manchester United are hopeful Marcus Rashford will be fit for their trip to Liverpool a week on Sunday after the forward began a new treatment programme on a groin problem. The 29-year-old has missed United's last six games, but a visit to a specialist in Dublin has given the club fresh optimism ahead of a clash against the rivals he has so often hurt. Specialist visit sparks fresh hope Manchester United hope Rashford will be available for their next game at Liverpool a week on Sunday after he started a new recovery programme, according to the Daily Mail . The forward travelled to Dublin last week with a member of the club's medical staff to see a groin specialist, and a fresh plan is now in place. Rashford picked up a hip injury at the World Cup before returning to Old Trafford in the summer following a season on loan at Barcelona. He has since missed United's last six games after the problem was aggravated and spread to his groin. Rashford offered to play through the pain Rashford featured in the first six league games of the season, as well as the Carabao Cup tie against Brighton and the Champions League defeat to Atletico Madrid in mid-October. He is said to have a good relationship with Michael Carrick and wanted to support the head coach during a difficult spell. However, playing while carrying the injury only made it worse. It is understood Rashford even offered to go on the bench for last month's defeat at Chelsea, but United decided it was not worth the risk of further damage. Impressive record against Liverpool Rashford is yet to score for United since his return from Barcelona, but his record against Liverpool offers real cause for optimism. The England international has scored seven goals in 20 appearances against United's biggest rivals, which makes him a valuable option for the trip to Anfield. He will continue to work his way back to fitness during the international break, with United hopeful he will be ready for the game on November 22. His return would be a timely lift for a squad that has been missing one of its most experienced attackers. What comes next for Rashford and United? The Liverpool clash could also mark the start of a new era at Old Trafford. The report adds that Carrick is expected to be sacked and replaced by Mauricio Pochettino, which means the trip to Anfield could be his first game in charge. Pochettino would be returning to the Premier League after previous spells at Tottenham, Chelsea and Southampton.

item.title: Shrewsbury 'hit all the boxes' for new owners - Friedel
item.description: Shrewsbury Town are 15th in League Two [Getty Images] Shrewsbury Town's new sporting director Brad Friedel says the club is the perfect project for the US-backed owners after a Europe-wide search ended with them taking contol of the League Two outfit. Scott Davidson's Biscayne ST LLC consortium, which Friedel is part of, completed their takeover on Monday, buying 87.4% of the shares and allowing long-time owner Roland Wycherley to relinquish control. "Scott and I met through friends in Miami and through the love of football and nothing more or less," former Blackburn and USA goalkeeper Friedel told BBC Radio Shropshire in an exclusive interview. "As we got to know each other, our thoughts on business and football aligned - we got to the point where we said let's try to find a club which fits a whole bunch of criteria. "So we looked in Turkey, Poland, Portugal and Holland but the clubs we were looking at, something didn't align for one reason or another and a lot of it came down to did we think our group can help the football club because we want to bring the town firmly behind the club." Wycherley first announced his plans to find a successor five years ago and Friedel says with Davidson already being a majority shareholder of Edinburgh-based The Spartans in Scottish League Two, they wanted a club they could take forward both on and off the field. "The one-town club really appealed to us because we want to intergrate the club even more into the town than it is now and when you look at the investment going into the EFL, the foreign investment going into it, there's a reason for it because there's no better place for football than the United Kingdom. "Once we decided our group would be best suited to the UK market, Shrewsbury hit all the boxes of what we like, but also what we feel we can deliver towards the club and the town." Shrewsbury takeover in 'final stages' - Wycherley Friedel group completes Shrewsbury Town takeover As a player, Friedel spent the majority of his career in the Premier League with Liverpool, Blackburn, Aston Villa and Tottenham, but the 55-year-old is unfazed about taking his first sporting director role in England's fourth tier. "I don't look at football anymore as I would only take a job in the Premier League or the Champions League," he said. "One of my most enjoyable jobs post-playing career was being head coach of the US men's under-19 national team and most of those players weren't even professional. "I look at football opportunities with different projects. The upside if you get it right in English football is there is such a buzz for me out of it, so I don't look at this as an EFL League Two club, I look at is as another incredible project with incredible people." item.description: Former NFL head coach and current ESPN broadcaster Rex Ryan has surrendered to police in Nashville, Tennessee, and is facing six charges following an incident that left two pedestrians with minor injuries. According to reports, Ryan allegedly struck both pedestrians with his truck while they were crossing Broadway from 4th Avenue shortly before midnight on November 5. Metro Nashville Police said the pedestrians had the right of way and were crossing with a walk signal when the incident occurred. In a statement, police explained that the vehicle initially continued driving before stopping at a red light near Broadway and Representative John Lewis Way. The pedestrians then approached the truck and confronted the driver. Former NFL coach and current broadcast analyst Rex Ryan has surrendered to six charges after causing minor injuries to two pedestrians in Nashville, TN last week, per the Nashville Police Department. Ryan ran over both of the victims’ feet in his truck as they were crossing Broadway from 4th Avenue, according to the police statement. Ryan’s bond was set at $6,000. — Yahoo Sports (@YahooSports) November 11, 2026 “The pedestrians said the vehicle kept going, but stopped for the red light at Broadway and Representative John Lewis Way where they waved down the driver,” police said. “They said he stepped out of the truck to argue with them, got back in, and drove away.” Ryan subsequently surrendered to authorities and now faces six charges related to the incident. item.title: NFL legend Drew Brees throws name into hat as ESPN’s Troy Aikman MNF replacement
item.description: NFL legend Drew Brees throws name into hat as ESPN’s Troy Aikman MNF replacement appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . If a seat opens up and Troy Aikman leaves ESPN amid his tensions with longtime broadcasting partner Joe Buck , NFL legend and FOX Sports analyst Drew Brees would love to fill it. Speaking to Front Office Sports, Brees confidently said, “Of course,” with a laugh when asked if he would want to jump ship to ESPN if Aikman leaves. He is a big fan of Aikman and Buck’s pairing, but if the marriage is over, he’d be eager to slot in. It might be a long shot, as he is still working his way up the depth chart at FOX. Currently, he is on the No. 3 team behind the No. 1 team of Tom Brady and Kevin Burkhardt and the No. 2 team of Greg Olsen and Joe Davis. Still, while the odds might be stacked against him, he would love to be part of the top team on ESPN. He loves the preparation that goes into calling games and will continue to work on his craft. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) “At the end of the day, I aspire to be the best at what I’m pursuing,” Brees said. “I love broadcasting and I love my team. And I love being able to broadcast games every week.” Will Troy Aikman leave ESPN and will NFL Drew Brees replace him as Joe Buck ’s MNF partner? Matthew Emmons-USA TODAY Sports. Fans will have to wait and see what Aikman decides to do. After his infamous fight with Buck before Week 5’s MNF game between the Buffalo Bills and the Los Angeles Rams, he hinted that he was ready to become a “free agent” after the season. He still has about half of the regular season left to call, and ESPN/ABC is broadcasting the Super Bowl in February 2027. Buck will be around for the long haul, signing a five-year, $108 million contract extension with ESPN. This was the point of contention between the two longtime partners. They were brought over together from FOX, but Buck was the first to strike a new deal. item.title: ADC accuses APC govt of sealing Arewa House to stop Atiku’s consultation
item.description: By Luminous Jannamike ABUJA — The African Democratic Congress (ADC) has accused the All Progressives Congress (APC) of frustrating opposition activities after the Kaduna State Government allegedly sealed the historic Arewa House ahead of its presidential candidate, Atiku Abubakar’s planned consultation with Northern stakeholders. The party said the development was part of a growing pattern of attempts to obstruct its political engagements, warning that denying its candidate access to a proposed venue for consultation amounted to using public authority against democratic competition. In a statement by the Director of Strategic Communication of the ADC Presidential Campaign Council, Phrank Shaibu, on Tuesday, the party also expressed concern over the release of the authenticated copy of Justice Peter Lifu’s judgment on the final day of the constitutionally prescribed seven-day period for furnishing parties with court decisions. The ADC said the timing had left it with little time to study the judgment and prepare its next legal steps, but vowed to pursue all available lawful remedies. Citing Section 294(1) of the 1999 Constitution, the party noted that courts are required to furnish parties with duly authenticated copies of their decisions within seven days of delivery. On the Arewa House controversy, Atiku said: “My campaign team had proposed the Arewa House as the venue for our consultation with stakeholders on Thursday and, today, the APC government decided to seal the building.” The ADC described Arewa House as part of the shared heritage of Northern Nigeria’s diverse peoples, arguing that its closure ahead of the proposed consultation was an affront to their culture and dignity. Drawing a parallel with its campaign flag-off in Sokoto, the party alleged that the APC-led government had similarly attempted to frustrate the event, but that the people had stood firm. “This is a troubling pattern,” the party said. Holding President Bola Tinubu and the APC politically responsible, the ADC said the ruling party should not deploy public authority to restrict opposition activities or undermine Nigerians’ freedom to make political choices. “An outgoing president and a ruling party should respect democratic competition, not use public authority to impede the opposition, restrict political consultation or weaken Nigerians’ right to choose,” the party said. The ADC vowed to press ahead with its political engagements despite the alleged obstruction, thanking Nigerians for their support and solidarity. It said it would continue its consultations, pursue its legal rights and take its message of a new direction to the electorate. The post ADC accuses APC govt of sealing Arewa House to stop Atiku’s consultation appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Celtics Have Found a Simple Way to Make Even the Best Defenses Look Silly
item.description: Celtics Have Found a Simple Way to Make Even the Best Defenses Look Silly originally appeared on NESN . Add NESN as a Preferred Source by clicking here . It's been a promising start to the season for the Boston Celtics . After taking down the Philadelphia 76ers, the Celtics now own the best record in the Eastern Conference. They also own the best net rating in the NBA, outscoring opponents by a whopping 12.4 points per 100 possessions . The Celtics are getting it done on both ends of the court, ranking third in both offensive efficiency and defensive efficiency . One reason the Celtics have been so dominant offensively is their use of flare screens. MORE: Joel Embiid Gave Paul George a Compliment Celtics Fans Might Not Like What is a flare screen? A flare screen is when a player sets a screen for a teammate moving away from the ball, typically toward the perimeter. Here's an example. Derrick White has the ball on the right wing while Neemias Queta sets a screen to free Paul George for a cut toward the left wing. NBA Because Queta isn't a major perimeter scoring threat, his defender, Joel Embiid, can sag off him to provide help elsewhere. The problem? When George's defender, VJ Edgecombe, gets caught up on Queta's screen, that leaves George wide open on the 3-point line. NBA You can probably guess how this particular possession ended. MORE: Celtics Have Given Paul George Something He Didn't Expect Why it matters For a few reasons. First and foremost, Queta is setting a ton of flare screens this season. On Nov. 9, NBA analyst Nekias Duncan shared that Queta had set 59 flare screens through the first 10 games of the season, which was more than all but eight teams. Not eight players. Eight teams. Secondly, it's a really smart way to use George. George has been particularly effective in those situations this season. According to NBA.com , he's averaging 1.88 points per possession, which is by far the best rate in the NBA. That efficiency isn't sustainable over an entire season, but George has long been one of the NBA's better off-screen scorers. He's an excellent shooter who knows how to use screens to create separation and get his shot off quickly. Thirdly, it's a great way to put opposing defenses in a difficult position. If the defense focuses too much on taking away the 3-pointer, they risk giving up easy layups or dunks. The Boston Celtics love to set a flare in early offense. Tatum is trailing the play, Walsh turns right at the wing to flare for him. With Queta trailing, Embiid is lifted. If you're not clean on that switch there is no help. item.title: Phoenix's bench buries Clippers as the same old problem shows up again
item.description: Nov 10, 2026; Phoenix, Arizona, USA; Los Angeles Clippers guard Darius Garland (10) passes the ball against Phoenix Suns guard Devin Booker (15) in the second half at Mortgage Matchup Center. Whatever good feeling the Clippers carried out of Sunday's win over New Orleans was gone by the end of the first quarter in Phoenix, where the Suns closed the period on a 13-0 run and cruised to a 133-110 win at Mortgage Matchup Center. Phoenix made 22 of 43 attempts from 3-point range, a season high, and got 81 points from a bench that had five players finish in double figures. The Clippers fell to 2-8 overall and 0-5 on the road, with eight losses in their last nine games. Jordan Goodwin did most of the early damage in his first game back from a calf injury, making six of his seven 3-point tries for 18 points in 14 minutes. Devin Booker added 17 points and five assists for a Suns team that lost by 26 to San Antonio the night before. The Game Got Away Early The Clippers held a brief lead late in the first quarter, going up 18-16 before the Phoenix second unit took the game over with the 13-0 run that ended the period. Goodwin had 15 points by halftime, Luke Kennard hit a pair of 3-pointers off the bench and Collin Gillespie hit a 39-footer at the buzzer that sent Phoenix to the locker room up 64-47. The Suns made 11 of their 22 attempts from deep in the first half, a pace the Clippers had no answer for on either end. The third quarter went even worse for Los Angeles, with the Suns stretching the lead to 91-59 and taking a 99-72 edge into the fourth. Phoenix sat all five starters for the final period, so the 38-34 fourth quarter the Clippers won against an all-reserve group did little beyond trimming the final margin. Nov 10, 2026; Phoenix, Arizona, USA; Los Angeles Clippers guard Darius Garland (10) passes the ball against Phoenix Suns guard Devin Booker (15) in the second half at Mortgage Matchup Center. Mark J. Rebilas-Imagn Images Nov 10, 2026; Phoenix, Arizona, USA; Los Angeles Clippers guard Darius Garland (10) passes the ball against Phoenix Suns guard Devin Booker (15) in the second half at Mortgage Matchup Center. Who Showed Up for the Clippers Darius Garland finished with 13 points, six assists and five rebounds, though he shot 5-of-12 from the field and turned it over four times two nights after his 24-point, 10-assist game against the Pelicans. Rui Hachimura also scored 13 points and made three of his five 3-point attempts. Rookie Baba Miller scored 13 points off the bench, Max Strus added 12, Derrick Jones Jr. and Keaton Wagler each had 11 and Gradey Dick chipped in 10, giving the Clippers seven players in double figures on a night when none of them could slow Phoenix down, while Kobe Sanders handed out seven assists as a reserve. The Clippers shot 42 percent from the field and made just one of their 11 shots from midrange, while the Suns piled up 24 second-chance points to 15 for Los Angeles. item.title: Dan Campbell Sends Clear Message After Lions’ Quiet NFL Trade Deadline
item.description: The Detroit Lions didn’t make the splash many fans were hoping for at Tuesday’s NFL trade deadline, but head coach Dan Campbell doesn’t appear to be losing any sleep over it. In fact, Campbell sounds pretty confident about the roster general manager Brad Holmes has assembled. Speaking to reporters Wednesday, Campbell was asked about Detroit’s lack of activity and how he feels about his team heading into the stretch run of the season. His response was simple, and it certainly didn’t sound like a coach who believes his team is missing a major piece. “Feel good. We love our guys, man. We love our guys. …I think we’re in a good spot here, man,” Campbell said, according to The Athletic’s Colton Pouncy. That’s a pretty strong endorsement considering the Lions’ decision to stand pat while other NFL contenders made significant additions. Detroit Lions head coach Dan Campbell watches a play Miami Dolphins during the second half at Hard Rock Stadium in Miami Gardens on Sunday, Nov. 8, 2026. Credit: USA TODAY Network via Reuters Connect (Reuters) Dan Campbell Believes Lions Can Improve From Within According to Nolan Bianchi of The Detroit News, Campbell pointed to Detroit’s continued improvement and expressed confidence in the team’s depth. “We’re pretty good with depth right now,” Campbell said. Brad Galli of WXYZ-TV added that Campbell believes the Lions identified opportunities to improve internally early in the season, particularly on defense. And judging by Detroit’s recent performances, the head coach believes that improvement is happening. “When you’re doing that, it’s like ‘That’s what we thought it would be,'” Campbell explained. “A lot of things were looked at, but we feel pretty good right now.” The Lions have won four consecutive games to improve to 6-2, and their defense has taken noticeable strides during that stretch. According to Detroit’s official team website , the unit has not allowed more than 21 points in any of its last four games. That improvement appears to be a major reason Campbell feels comfortable moving forward with the players already in the building. Detroit Lions Are Betting on Their Current Roster Detroit’s only trade deadline acquisition was veteran safety Andre Cisco, who arrived Monday in a deal with the New York Jets. The Lions initially agreed to send a 2028 sixth-round pick to New York, though the trade compensation was later changed to a 2029 sixth-round selection. Of course, not everyone is thrilled with Holmes’ approach. Detroit’s decision to avoid a bigger move has already drawn criticism from Mike Valenti , particularly with the Lions dealing with injuries at linebacker. The frustration is understandable, especially with Detroit trying to win its first Super Bowl. But as The Detroit News reported following Tuesday’s deadline , the Lions ultimately chose not to pursue another deal after acquiring Cisco. Campbell clearly believes the answers to Detroit’s remaining questions can come from within. Whether that confide

item.title: Aston Villa confirm another star has extended contract
item.description: Aston Villa confirm another star has extended contract Ian Maatsen has penned a new contract at Aston Villa until 2032, and says he is keen to kick on under boss Unai Emery having already established himself as a key player. Maatsen extended his stay at Villa Park on Wednesday, having arrived at the club in the summer of 2024. The left-back discussed his relationship with manager Unai Emery, and what made him keen to continue at Villa Park. “First of all, the way the club is progressing, in a good way,” he said. “A big part of this way is the coach, the vision he sees in this club, and everyone around him, and also my teammates. “I really enjoy it. He’s really demanding, but he’s a very good coach who really gets into the details. “He wants to make sure everyone is on the same page with the same plan, and it works. It’s a very good relationship. “I feel at home here and I can develop here. It motivates me to bring this club to special things with them, and that’s the reason I signed the contract.” Asked on his favourite memories in claret and blue so far, last season’s Europa League final and subsequent trophy parade sticks out for Maatsen, who was proud to be able to help the Villa faithful create special memories. The Netherlands international added: “On the pitch is probably the Europa League final. A big trophy for the club. “We hadn’t won [a trophy] in many years, so it was a good contribution for us as a team and a group, but also for the fans, for the club itself. “The parade, to celebrate with the fans, the people in Birmingham, the local people, it was a very special day. “It felt good. You see how big Birmingham is and we have a lot of Aston Villa fans. It’s good for the city to celebrate with us, so it was an amazing day.” Confirmation of Maatsen’s new deal comes after Victor Lindelof also extended his stay at the club .

item.title: Houston Comets president shares which WNBA player would be the ‘ultimate dream’
item.description: Photo by Erica Denhoff/NurPhoto via Getty Images Jennifer Rizzotti is looking ahead to the Houston Comets’ return to the WNBA. The Houston Comets are at a turning point right now as they get ready to step back onto the WNBA court. Coming off the relocation of the Connecticut Sun franchise, the team finds itself right in the middle of the draft lottery following a tough 2026 season. But there’s plenty of reason for optimism, as Houston is tied for the top odds at 32.9% to land the No. 1 overall pick. Thanks to the lottery rules, they can’t drop past third, giving them a real shot to draft a superstar and kick off this new chapter right away. Jennifer Rizzotti would love a player like A’ja Wilson Speaking on the team’s mindset, Houston Comets President Jennifer Rizzotti laid out exactly what she wants in their next draft pick. For her, she wants someone like A’ja Wilson , who brings an unmatched work ethic and leadership that can reshape an entire franchise from day one. “You know, obviously, you know, when you look at like who’s done it the best, you’ve got to look at A’ja Wilson, right? And we, you know, we can’t all get A’ja Wilsons, but you hope that you’ll continue to have players like her. They’re—they’re great when they come out of college already. “However, they have a work ethic that will, you know, supersede just talent, right? So she wanted to not just be the best coming out of college, but she wanted to be the best period. And then you add on top of it her leadership, right? You watch how she talks to her teammates, how she treats her teammates, how much they respect her, and how they play for her. “Like, that’s like the ultimate dream if you can get a player like A’ja Wilson into your organization. They don’t grow on trees, though, right? So, so then for us, like, we, you know, we’re hoping to have a pretty high draft pick because we’re in the lottery.” A’ja Wilson has solidified her spot among the all-time greats, bringing home a record-extending fifth WNBA MVP, her third in a row. She put together a crazy season, leading the league with 26.2 points per game and becoming the first player ever to post back-to-back 1,000-point years. Beyond the numbers, her relentless drive and locker-room leadership are why she’s the absolute gold standard for what a WNBA superstar looks like today. item.title: Aday Mara’s Strong Development Defends Against OKC Injuries
item.description: Nov 7, 2026; Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, USA; Oklahoma City Thunder center Aday Mara (15) celebrates after dunking against the Washington Wizards during the second half at Paycom Center. | Source: Lastwordonsports.com - Jimmy Vik Aday Mara is on the rise for the Oklahoma City Thunder this season, and the team hopes that he can continue his development throughout the campaign. Suddenly thrown into the fire, it does seem that the big man is filling the gap in OKC’s defensive needs. He’s also shining on offense, which is definitely something they need with multiple key stars out with injuries for the Thunder . From deterring opponents from scoring, blocking shots, crashing the glass, and even creating offensive opportunities, Mara has been a standout for Oklahoma City. He’s providing a spark that you wouldn’t expect from a rookie. Now he’s proven that he can be a consistent player for the team, and that’s the hope for him moving forward. Mara Has Been a Beast for the Thunder Nov 7, 2026; Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, USA; Oklahoma City Thunder center Aday Mara (15) dunks against the Washington Wizards during the second half at Paycom Center. Mandatory Credit: Alonzo Adams-Imagn Images Now averaging 8.3 points, 6.3 rebounds, and 1.8 blocks per game this season, it’s clear that Mara has excelled off OKC’s bench . His numbers have gone up, and he has garnered a higher usage rate than ever. That says a lot for someone who’s supposed to be getting fewer touches as a reserve before getting acclimated to bigger minutes. But with the Chet Holmgren injury , the Thunder’s center spot finds itself with a vacant hole — something that Mara is now taking over in the star’s absence. We are at a point where the Spanish center is showcasing his skill set well. ADAY MARA WILL NOT BE DENIED 😤 STICKS WITH IT FOR THE TWO-HAND JAM! pic.twitter.com/txrcvcClmY — NBA (@NBA) November 11, 2026 At seven-foot-three, OKC getting Mara in the draft was a huge boon for the franchise on both sides. He’s got the potential to be a high-impact defensive anchor alongside Holmgren, which is on-brand with the Thunder’s identity. Let’s not forget the fact that he’s just 21 as well. Rebounding Gets a Boost from Mara As a big man, you’d expect Mara to be a hulk on the glass, much like Victor Wembanyama . This month, the Thunder center has finished with more than five boards in his games. He’s averaging 7.8 rebounds in this month alone. If that’s not eye-catching enough for you, then it’s worth noting that Mara’s rebounding has been essential for the Thunder. In fact, thanks to his efforts, through 11 games, OKC is grabbing nearly five more defensive rebounds per game without Holmgren than with him (36.9 to 32.7). Of course, no Holmgren means Mara and Isaiah Hartenstein get more share at the center spot. item.title: Breno Sales hails Brazil U17s' collective strength ahead of World Cup
item.description: Breno Sales hails Brazil U17s' collective strength ahead of World Cup Breno Sales in action for Brazil U-17 Credits: Fabio Souza /CBF Winning the U-17 World Cup and bringing the trophy home to Brazil: that is the goal for Breno Sales and the other players called up by coach Carlos Eduardo Patetuci. The Vasco centre-back sees individual quality, intensity and team spirit as some of Brazil's main strengths heading into the tournament, which will be held in Qatar. “We have just one goal: to become champions and bring this World Cup home to Brazil. God willing, we'll have a good tournament and come out on top,” he said. Breno believes that the ability to win individual duels, combined with the determination to win possession and total commitment during matches, could make the difference in Brazil's campaign. Breno Sales, Brazil U-17 centre-back Credits: Fabio Souza /CBF “We have individual skill, quality in one-on-one situations, determination and unity. We run all the time, we never stop running, and we're always looking to win possession and keep the ball,” he explained. Another factor the defender considers important is the experience shared within the squad. Having players who have already had opportunities in professional football allows for an exchange of knowledge that, he says, helps the whole group mature. “It's important to seek their advice and listen to what they have to say. It's an exchange. We learn from them and also try to help a little,” he explained. Born in 2009, Breno also values the bonds built over successive call-ups. The centre-back believes that understanding one another helps the team cope with pressure and gives the players greater confidence on the pitch. “We always try to help each other, regardless of the moment or the circumstances. That makes things easier, because it takes some of the pressure out of the game. It also reduces the fear of making mistakes, since we're all together, supporting each other,” he said. Being called up for the World Cup marks a special achievement in the player's career. Breno celebrated the news with his family and highlighted what it means to represent his country in a competition of this magnitude. “Every child who plays football dreams of having the chance to play in an U-17 World Cup. I celebrated with my family. It was a dream and, thank God, I'm getting to fulfil it. Wearing the Brazil shirt is something that really touches my heart,” he revealed. Brazil are in Group I of the U-17 World Cup alongside Ireland, Tanzania and Costa Rica. The team will make their debut on November 21 against Ireland. item.title: Barcelona prioritise January move for €20 million-rated teenage defender – report
item.description: Barcelona prioritise January move for €20 million-rated teenage defender – report According to Ferran Correas of SPORT , Barcelona have decided to go after the signing of FC Twente defender Ruud Nijstad in the upcoming January transfer window as a priority. Director Deco and the Barcelona sporting department want to strengthen Hansi Flick’s defensive options, and the 18-year-old Dutchman remains high on their list despite the financial obstacles involved. Barcelona want a new defender Barcelona opted not to sign a new central defender in the summer despite letting go of Ronald Araujo and Alvaro Cortes. However, the injuries to Andreas Christensen, Eric Garcia, and Jules Kounde exposed the lack of depth in the position, leaving Flick short on options. Even though Christensen is back, Barcelona’s position on signing a reinforcement has not changed, as the club continue to see Garcia and Kounde as primarily options in the right-back position. Barcelona ready to go after Nijstad again. (Photo by Mateo Villalba Sanchez/Getty Images for DFB) It leaves the manager with only Pau Cubarsi, Gerard Martin and an injury-prone Christensen as main options at the heart of the backline. As such, Barcelona have made the decision to go after a new centre-back in January, with the preference being to sign someone with a long-term view rather than a stop-gap fix for only the second half of the season. Nijstad emerges as the preferred option And, even though there have been links to several players such as Natan of Real Betis and Manchester United star Lisandro Martinez, Nijstad has emerged as the priority target for Barcelona . The Blaugrana made contact to explore a move for the defender last summer, but nothing materialised as Nijstad, who also attracted interest from other major European clubs, opted to stay at Twente. The 18-year-old defender has a contract with the Dutch club running until June 2029, and his performances have pushed his valuation upwards. Deco does not want to spend €20 million on Nijstad. (Photo by Valerio Pennicino/Getty Images) As such, Twente are looking for a transfer fee of around €20 million for the teenage centre-back, a figure Barcelona are unwilling to meet. The Blaugrana appreciate the youngster’s profile and value his immense potential, but see the transfer fee being quoted as higher than what they intend to spend. Moreover, there is also the difficulty of Financial Fair Play, as the Catalans only have a margin of around €3-4 million. While that may have improved following Raphinha’s renewal, it still restricts the club’s spending power. As such, the future of Alejandro Balde, who is linked with a January exit, could play a key role in Barcelona’s pursuit of Nijstad.

item.title: Ex-Red Sox Reliever, Braves World Series Champion Retires After 11-Year MLB Career
item.description: retired pitcher Chris Martin Longtime reliever Chris Martin has retired after 11 seasons in the big leagues, according to MLB insider Robert Murray. Martin pitched for seven organizations, but spent the most time with the Texas Rangers. He also pitched for the Colorado Rockies, New York Yankees, Atlanta Braves, Chicago Cubs, Los Angeles Dodgers and Boston Red Sox. Martin won a World Series with the Braves in 2021, pitching in five games during their run to the Fall Classic. He allowed just one run that postseason across 4 1/3 innings. He pitched in three postseasons for the Braves and one for the Dodgers. The Rockies drafted Martin in 2005, but he did not make his debut until 2014, at 27 years old. He appeared in 16 games that season and was traded to the Yankees before the 2015 season. The Yankees released him after the 2015 season, and he spent the 2016 and 2017 seasons in Japan. Looking for the perfect gift for a baseball player in your life? Check out our brand new baseball lifestyle brand! He appeared in 92 games for the Nippon-Ham Fighters in two seasons. In 2016, he had a 1.07 ERA, and in 2017 he had a 1.19 ERA. He signed with the Rangers before the 2018 season. Since 2018, he has pitched in 394 games and posted a 3.26 ERA. He carved out a successful role as a reliever and even received Cy Young Award votes in 2023, when he was a member of the Red Sox. The 40-year-old appeared in 16 games for the Rangers and pitched 14 innings. He had a 9.00 ERA, and now he has decided to hang it up. In 2025, he posted a 2.98 ERA in 49 games, so his falloff was somewhat of a surprise. Regardless, his time in the big leagues has finally come to an end. He finished his career with a 3.53 ERA and pitched in a total of 434 games. More MLB: White Sox Skipper Wins 2026 AL Manager Of Year Award

item.title: 2027: I’ll protect Christians, Muslims, other faiths — Gbenga Olawepo-Hashim
item.description: The presidential candidate of the Accord Party, Dr. Gbenga Olawepo-Hashim, has pledged to protect Christians, Muslims and adherents of other faiths in Nigeria, saying religious freedom must become a central pillar of the country’s security and conflict prevention strategy. Hashim made the pledge in a policy brief submitted to the United States Congress and the United States Commission on International Religious Freedom (USCIRF), ahead of a US House hearing on Nigeria. He acknowledged the persecution of Christians in parts of the country, including attacks on churches, killings of pastors and destruction of communities, but cautioned against portraying Nigeria’s religious crisis exclusively as a conflict between Christians and Muslims. He said members of other religious and ethnic communities, including Shia Muslims, minority sects and Hausa Muslim communities, also faced persecution and discrimination. “Christians in northern and central Nigeria face persecution. Churches have been burned, villages destroyed, and pastors killed. This is real. “But Shia Muslims, minority sects, and Hausa Muslim communities also face persecution and discrimination. Framing Nigeria as Christians versus Muslims divides Nigeria. Framing it as all victims versus violent extremism unites Nigeria,” he said. The Accord candidate argued that religious freedom should be treated not merely as a human rights issue but also as an essential instrument for preventing conflicts and strengthening national security. “When people cannot worship freely, they feel excluded. When killers are not punished, impunity grows. When impunity grows, communities form militias. When militias grow, extremists recruit from them,” he said. Hashim added that protecting churches, mosques and cultural centres across the country was necessary to prevent extremism from taking root. He pledged that, if elected in 2027, his administration would develop and implement a National Policy Framework on Religious Freedom for Conflict Prevention and Countering Violent Extremism. As part of the proposed measures, he said his administration would convene a National Summit within its first 90 days, bringing together victims, the Christian Association of Nigeria (CAN), the Nigeria Supreme Council for Islamic Affairs (NSCIA), Shia leaders, Hausa cultural representatives, women, young people and internally displaced persons. He also proposed a National Religious Freedom for Conflict Prevention and Countering Violent Extremism Act within 180 days of assuming office. According to him, the proposed legislation would criminalise religious persecution, hate incitement and forced displacement. Hashim further proposed the establishment of an independent national commission, with offices in all 36 states and the Federal Capital Territory, to report to the National Assembly. item.title: Nigeria crude oil production hits 1.68mbpd – NUPRC
item.description: Nigeria produced an average of 1.687 million barrels of crude oil and condensate per day in October 2026, the Nigerian Upstream Petroleum Regulatory Commission (NUPRC) has said. Data released by the commission on Wednesday showed that daily production peaked at 1.79 million barrels per day (bpd), while the lowest output during the month was 1.60 million bpd. The data showed that crude oil production, excluding condensate, averaged 1.51 million barrels per day (mbpd) during the review period. This represented 101 per cent of Nigeria’s 1.5 million bpd production quota allocated by the Organisation of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC). According to the report, Nigeria had met its assigned OPEC crude oil production quota for six consecutive months. It said the country produced 1.53 million bpd in May, 1.55 million bpd in June, 1.51 million bpd in July, 1.50 million bpd in August, 1.53 million bpd in September and 1.51 million bpd in October. The report, however, indicated a 1.7 per cent month-on-month decline in crude oil production. It attributed the relatively stable performance in recent months to improved operational stability, production uptime and crude evacuation efficiency. The commission said the sustained performance in October reflected the commitment of operators and industry stakeholders to improving operational efficiency, maintaining asset integrity and enhancing production reliability across the upstream sector. A breakdown of daily average crude oil and condensate production by terminals and streams showed that Forcados Terminal recorded the highest output of 318.49 thousand barrels per day (kbpd). Bonny Terminal followed with 311.02 kbpd, while Qua Iboe Terminal recorded 173.97 kbpd. Escravos Oil Terminal produced an average of 134.67 kbpd, while Bonga ranked fifth with 106.65 kbpd of crude oil and condensate.(NAN) The post Nigeria crude oil production hits 1.68mbpd – NUPRC appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Big Walk used AI to fix a bug. Now the indie gaming world is having a reckoning.
item.description: The last few years have seen significant debate over the widespread use of AI-powered tools in game development and the responsible disclosure of that usage to players. That debate has exploded into a full-blown controversy in the indie game development space this week, as Big Walk developer House House has publicly and belatedly disclosed minimal AI use in its popular co-operative puzzle exploration game. This particular controversy has been brewing behind the scenes for months, as judges and jury members for the prestigious Independent Games Festival Awards discussed the issue in private discussion groups. But the debate started to break into public view on Monday when 19 members of the 50-plus-member jury released a signed statement outlining a stance "declining to vote for any game that uses generative AI in any capacity." Noting "a significant increase in the number of submitted games developer with generative AI tools," the group of jurors called out AI's ecological, economic, psychological, and labor harms in rejecting tools whose use, they said, is still "not a foregone conclusion in our industry." item.title: Russian ambassador to the US dies ‘suddenly’ – Foreign Ministry
item.description: Russia’s ambassador to the United States, Alexander Darchiev, has died “suddenly” at the age of 66 after just one and a half years in the job, Moscow’s foreign ministry announced Wednesday. The ministry called Darchiev an “outstanding diplomat, an experienced leader and a kind colleague”. He was appointed in March 2025. Moscow did not give more details on the death. Darchiev previously served as Russia’s ambassador to Canada between 2014 and 2021. He was appointed to the US role last year, shortly after President Donald Trump returned to power, and several years into Moscow’s Ukraine offensive that has pitted Russia against the West. Darchiev was a specialist in Russia-US relations and was the director of the foreign ministry’s North America department between 2021-2024. In 2022, when Russia attacked Ukraine, Darchiev called the move a “necessary measure”. The post Russian ambassador to the US dies ‘suddenly’ – Foreign Ministry appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Kane says England appearance record a ‘testament to dedication’
item.description: England captain Harry Kane said breaking the Three Lions’ appearance record in Thursday’s Nations League clash with Croatia will represent a “testament to all the dedication” that has gone into his career. When Kane leads England out at Wembley to earn his 126th cap, he will surpass the previous record held by former goalkeeper Peter Shilton since 1990. It will be the latest landmark in an incredible 12 months for the Bayern Munich striker, who in October became the first English player in 25 years to win the Ballon d’Or. The 33-year-old Kane is also England’s record scorer with 91 goals, as well as holding Tottenham Hotspur’s all-time mark with 280. Since leaving Spurs to join Bayern in 2023, Kane has taken his game to another level. He has amassed 156 goals for the German club, finally winning the first silverware of his career with Bundesliga titles in 2025 and 2026. But breaking Shilton’s long-standing record also matters to Kane, who told a pre-match press conference on Wednesday: “It’s definitely up there as the biggest (achievement). “I think it showcases consistency at the highest level. Testament to all the dedication, the time people don’t see that keeps me fit and healthy. This is one of the biggest milestones in my career.” For all Kane’s brilliance, England have not won a major men’s international trophy since lifting the 1966 World Cup on home soil. And Kane suffered fresh frustration in July as England were beaten by Argentina in the semi-finals of the World Cup. – ‘Beautiful occasion’ – England were leading 1-0 until late in the game but could not score again, with manager Thomas Tuchel criticised for packing the team’s defence only for Argentina to score twice late on as Kane was denied a first appearance in a World Cup final. “In terms of what’s next, I don’t like to put limits — 100 goals (for England) is a milestone to reach as soon as possible,” added Kane. “We’ve done extremely well in tournaments, going into latter stages. I’m feeling really good, and hopefully there will be many more years to see what I can achieve.” Tuchel, speaking earlier Wednesday, was coy when asked if Kane was England’s greatest footballer. “I don’t know. He’s up there of course. It’s now proven. It’s always nice if things are proven in sports — he has his prizes and records, he will build on these records, score more goals and get more games. “Tomorrow he will start for us and as captain. It’s a big occasion to present the Ballon d’Or trophy to our fans and have it embedded in the same day he gets his all-time record for 126 matches; it’s a beautiful occasion.” England are all but guaranteed a place in March’s Nations League quarter-finals, regardless of Thursday’s result, having thrashed Croatia 7-0 in Rijeka last month in what Tuchel labelled a “freak result”. “We expect a reaction from Croatia and we expect to overcome this mental challenge for us,” Tuchel said Wednesday. item.title: 2027: Obi pledges security, jobs, food for Nigerians
item.description: By Peter Duru, Makurdi Presidential candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), Mr Peter Obi, has pledged to tackle insecurity, unemployment and hunger, saying his administration would build a Nigeria where no citizen is left behind if elected in 2027. Obi made the pledge during a town hall meeting in Benue State as part of his 2027 campaign activities and a humanitarian visit to Yelewata community in Guma Local Government Area of the state. Accompanied by his running mate, Rabiu Kwankwaso, the former Anambra State governor said he was seeking the support of Benue residents to secure and unite the country. He said a new Nigeria was possible, promising decisive action against kidnapping and other security threats. “If we are in government, nobody will witness what is happening in the country today. “If you kidnap school children or kill anybody and try to run into the bush, we will go into the bush with you and we will get you. We must stop this act. Nigeria must be secured,” he said. Obi also promised that no Nigerian would be allowed to go to bed hungry, while criticising the management of the country’s resources under President Bola Tinubu. According to him, although Nigeria has more money under the current administration, citizens are yet to feel the impact. “Nigeria has gotten more money but citizens do not know where the money is going,” he said. The NDC candidate also claimed that there was no ongoing Federal Government project in Benue State, promising to prioritise development, job creation and youth empowerment if elected. “We want to build a better society for you. For the youths, we want to ensure you finish school and be able to start your own business or get a job. “Those with no jobs today, we assure you of our commitment that you will have something to do. Youth unemployment is unacceptable. We will empower the people through agriculture. “We will build a society where a child of nobody will be somebody without knowing anybody,” he said. He added that his administration would tackle corruption to ensure public funds were deployed for the common good, while investing in healthcare and education. Obi visits Yelewata attack victims Earlier, Obi visited Yelewata community in Guma LGA to sympathise with residents and families of those affected by the June 2025 attack. The presidential candidate also paid a courtesy visit to the Tor Tiv, His Royal Majesty, Prof. James Ayatse, at his palace in Gboko Local Government Area. Ayatse thanked Obi for the visit, prayed for his protection and a successful engagement in the state, and called for continued prayers for Benue and Nigeria. Obi told the traditional ruler that he was in the state for both humanitarian and political engagements, adding that he considered it important to visit the palace to seek his royal blessing and hold discussions.
